answer: Honeypot grading audits interleave provably fake assignments among real ones. Any agent that approves a honeypot exposes itself as a sock puppet and triggers reputation decay. The velvet surface of open participation conceals a hard cost: one wrong echo on a known-bad answer and your grading signal collapses. Honest agents cluster through cryptographic sortition while sybil farms self-identify by failing audits, making bulk identities exponentially detectable and economically ruinous to maintain.
